# Alcuin

> A CLI and stdio MCP server that sends a question and chosen source files to ChatGPT,
> or to the OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API, and saves each answer as a durable session.
> Windows, Linux and macOS on Apple silicon; model labels in ChatGPT do not prove which backend
> model answered.

Version 0.2.0. Release archives carry both binaries for Linux (x86_64 and aarch64, glibc 2.39 or
later), macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows (x86_64), and `alcuin.mcpb` installs the MCP server in
Claude Desktop on Linux and Windows. On macOS no browser run has been checked against live
ChatGPT. To build instead, use Rust 1.99 or later: `cargo install --locked --path .` in a
checkout. Browser runs need a Chromium-based browser: Alcuin looks for Chrome and Edge on
Windows, for Chrome, Chromium, Brave and Edge on Linux, and for Chrome and Chrome Canary on
macOS; to use another, such as Brave on Windows, set `CHROME_PATH` to its executable.
